maddeler.e:
اهتلكنا (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكْنَا (ihtalaknā) /ih.ta.lak.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكْنَا (uhtuliknā) /uh.tu.lik.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
